walkthroughs.body_html:
Unit 3: Extended Writing - Film and Literature — a core area of A-Level French.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Unit 3: Extended Writing - Film and Literature brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Unit 3: Extended Writing - Film and Literature.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: When does the past participle agree with avoir verbs?
options: Dans France.
When the direct object comes BEFORE the verb (la pomme que j'ai mangée).
Always.
Never - avoir never causes agreement.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I am going to Spain' in French?
options: Je vais à Espagne.
Always.
Je viens en Espagne.
Je vais en Espagne.
Always.
En France.
Dans France.
À France.
